scope: Four fixed non-branded discovery queries for esports mouse and AI device; a small browser SERP diagnostic, not traffic, Google/Baidu performance or whole-market SEO.
locale_rule: Query language and requested Bing language/region recorded; physical region, personalization and server experiment assignment are not independently verified.
sampling_rule: First ten organic web results in displayed order; exclude ads, AI answers, shopping, video carousels and knowledge panels. Fewer than ten verifiable organic entries is a coverage error, never a zero score. Retain every attempted query and errors.

queries.prompt: desktop AI device voice input hardware control
可换电池 轻量化 电竞鼠标
桌面 AI 设备 语音输入 硬件控制
